bodyHtml:
A concise reading guide to the original source, the discussion's attention signal, and the claims that still need verification.

The short version

In March, Windows Latest was the first to notice that Microsoft’s official Copilot Discord server was blocking messages containing “Microslop.” Anyone who tried to post it got a moderation warning, and people quickly started testing variations like “Microsl0p” to slip past the filter. Naturally, the situation escalated until Microsoft locked down parts of the server […]

This discussion is useful as a map of questions and reactions, not as independent proof. The most reliable takeaway comes from comparing Microsoft tried to ban "Microslop", and six months later it has given up with the primary evidence it cites.
